name: Lung Ming Green Energy Technology Engineering Co Ltd.
summary: Lung Ming Green Energy Technology Engineering Co., Ltd. offers crucial services in mechanical and electrical system integration, general construction, and waste management. These solutions are provided for a variety of projects, including high-tech facilities, industrial sites, and residential properties. The company's operations extend across Taiwan, mainland China, and Cambodia. It was founded on January 5, 1996, and its primary office is located in Taipei, Taiwan.
